tex_content.html: \begin{exercise} \end{exercise}1. chA:A.13Given a smooth map $F: M \to N$ and a point $p \in M$, show that $dF_p$ is a well-defined linear map from $T_p M$ to $T_{F(p)} N$. Show that the differential of the identity is the identity, and the differential of a composition is given by $d(G \circ F)_p = dG_{F(p)} \circ dF_p$. \end{exercise}
